title: Mapena language
text: Mapena is a Trans–New Guinea language spoken primarily in the Milne Bay Province of Papua New Guinea by a small indigenous community. Approximately 270 speakers were reported in 1973, with more recent estimates around 1,100 as of the 2020s.
